news.summary: AMA CEO John Whyte, M.D., told Fierce Healthcare the increasing use of AI in clinical functions is “raising urgent questions about clinical authority, oversight and accountability.”

news.title: Industry Voices—How physician practices can grow and succeed without the support of private equity
news.summary: For physicians who want to stay independent, there are several proven strategies to grow a successful practice, legal, financial and clinical experts write.

news.summary: The latest news from UMass Memorial Health, Elation Health, HealthTap, JAMA and more.

news.summary: The latest news from CMS and HHS this week: HHS demands info on ‘sex-rejecting procedures’ for minors, CMS releases more RHTP funds and more.

news.title: Epic teams up with Amazon Pharmacy, LillyDirect and Mark Cuban to launch prescription drug pricing tool
news.summary: Epic is bringing pharmacy price shopping directly into the doctor's office and the prescribing workflow.

news.title: NABIP sues CMS over moratorium on new ACA broker registrations
news.summary: The National Association of Benefits and Insurance Professionals is suing the Trump administration over its moratorium on new brokers entering the Affordable Care Act marketplaces.

news.title: Duke Health, CaroMont Health seek to jointly build, operate 2 Charlotte-area hospitals
news.summary: The pair filed Certificate of Needs with the state to build two hospitals comprising 200 beds in fast-growing North Carolina's Mecklenburg County.

news.title: China looks to ban foreign acquisitions of critical biopharma platforms
news.summary: As Washington ramps up efforts to tighten cross-border life sciences deals involving Chinese assets, Beijing is moving to tighten its own grip on biomedical innovation, rolling out a draft policy that would ban or restrict the export of key biopharmaceutical technologies.

news.title: SimBioSys nabs FDA clearance for Nvidia-powered, MRI-derived breast cancer recurrence tool
news.summary: SimBioSys has been given FDA clearance of the Nvidia-powered TumorSight Risk, an AI and MRI-derived prognostic tool for assessing the risk of a breast cancer coming back.

news.title: Chutes & Ladders—Bausch + Lomb's returning CEO Saunders exits again
news.summary: Bausch + Lomb CEO Brent Saunders is making a second exit from the eye health company, as the president of parent Bausch Health steps in temporarily. Plus, Paragon Labs is buying out Apogee talent after its acquisition by AbbVie.

news.title: FDA issues early alert for Edwards Lifesciences’ mitral valve delivery system after reported death, injury
news.summary: The FDA has issued an early alert for certain delivery systems used with Edwards Lifesciences’ SAPIEN M3 transcatheter mitral valve replacement system amid serious safety concerns.

news.title: ‘It’s certainly not easy’: How are Boston biotechs coping with a shallower pool of seed funding?
news.summary: As the world's biggest biotech hub, funding for early-stage startups has long been the lifeblood of Boston's life sciences industry. But the latest figures make for concerning reading—with average seed funding secured by a preclinical start-up plunging 40% over the past year.

news.title: Labcorp, Thrive Global launch latest Thrive 5 health test
news.summary: Labcorp has launched the Thrive 5 Health Test that is now offered through a collaboration with Arianna Huffington's behavior change technology company, Thrive Global.

news.title: OrbiMed’s largest-ever Asian fund contributes to $3B war chest

news.title: Osivax focuses on combo strategy for flu vaccine after phase 2 fail

news.summary: AstraZeneca is paying insitro $40 million upfront to find novel drug targets for liver and heart diseases using artificial intelligence.

papers.title: MorphAct: Robot Policies Morphing with the Worlds They Act In
papers.summary: Progress toward general intelligence in the physical world requires scaling robot learning across diverse environments and interactions. However, existing robot policies use shared parameters that remain fixed across interaction contexts. When different operations favor competing parameter adjustments, fitting their mixture can leave individual operations insufficiently adapted. papers.title: Execution Before Memory: Diagnosing Memory Failures in Video World Models
papers.summary: A memory test for a video world model should say whether the scene was set, whether the asked change was carried out, and whether the last frame shows the result. Current tests fold these into one number, so a low score is easy to read as forgetting. When the change is not carried out, the hidden state transition cannot appear, so the test is not really a test of memory. We introduce MIST, an evaluation that separates the change from the memory it should leave behind. papers.title: StopWatch: Goal Grounding for Object-goal Navigation
papers.summary: Pretrained VLMs bring rich world knowledge and semantic priors to object-goal navigation, and fine-tuning a VLM into a navigation policy has become a common recipe. Despite this progress, success rates remain low, and it is unclear which capability these fine-tuned policies lack. Our diagnosis identifies goal grounding as the dominant failure. These policies explore well, yet often fail to notice that the goal is already in view or to estimate how far away it is. To address this failure, we ground the goal explicitly.
